title: Receivables Aging by Customer
description: Open receivables per customer with days past due and current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over-90 day buckets as of a date.
sql:
SELECT hp.PARTY_NAME                                   AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
       hca.ACCOUNT_NUMBER                              AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER,
       ps.TRX_NUMBER                                   AS TRX_NUMBER,
       ctt.NAME                                        AS TRX_TYPE,
       ps.CLASS                                        AS TRX_CLASS,
       ps.TRX_DATE                                     AS TRX_DATE,
       ps.DUE_DATE                                     AS DUE_DATE,
       ps.INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE                        AS CURRENCY_CODE,
       TRUNC(:P_AS_OF_DATE) - TRUNC(ps.DUE_DATE)       AS DAYS_PAST_DUE,
       ps.AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING                         AS AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING,
       CASE WHEN TRUNC(:P_AS_OF_DATE) - TRUNC(ps.DUE_DATE) <= 0
            THEN ps.AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING ELSE 0 END    AS CURRENT_AMOUNT,
       CASE WHEN TRUNC(:P_AS_OF_DATE) - TRUNC(ps.DUE_DATE) BETWEEN 1 AND 30
            THEN ps.AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING ELSE 0 END    AS DAYS_1_30,
       CASE WHEN TRUNC(:P_AS_OF_DATE) - TRUNC(ps.DUE_DATE) BETWEEN 31 AND 60
            THEN ps.AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING ELSE 0 END    AS DAYS_31_60,
       CASE WHEN TRUNC(:P_AS_OF_DATE) - TRUNC(ps.DUE_DATE) BETWEEN 61 AND 90
            THEN ps.AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING ELSE 0 END    AS DAYS_61_90,
       CASE WHEN TRUNC(:P_AS_OF_DATE) - TRUNC(ps.DUE_DATE) > 90
            THEN ps.AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING ELSE 0 END    AS DAYS_OVER_90
FROM   AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL ps
JOIN   HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS hca      ON hca.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID = ps.CUSTOMER_ID
JOIN   HZ_PARTIES hp             ON hp.PARTY_ID = hca.PARTY_ID
LEFT JOIN RA_CUST_TRX_TYPES_ALL ctt ON ctt.CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID = ps.CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
WHERE  ps.STATUS = 'OP'
AND    ps.CLASS IN ('INV', 'DM', 'CB', 'CM')
AND    TRUNC(ps.GL_DATE) <= TRUNC(:P_AS_OF_DATE)
AND    (:P_ORG_ID IS NULL OR ps.ORG_ID = :P_ORG_ID)
AND    (:P_CUSTOMER_NUMBER IS NULL OR hca.ACCOUNT_NUMBER = :P_CUSTOMER_NUMBER)
ORDER BY hp.PARTY_NAME, hca.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, ps.DUE_DATE, ps.TRX_NUMBER
assumptions: Aging uses the current balance (STATUS = 'OP', AMOUNT_DUE_REMAINING), so it is an aging of today's open items bucketed against the as-of date, not a historical as-of balance; a true historical aging must back out applications and adjustments dated after the as-of date.
Includes invoices, debit memos, chargebacks and on-account credit memos (CLASS INV, DM, CB, CM); unapplied and on-account receipts (CLASS PMT) are excluded.
Items are included only if their GL date is on or before the as-of date.
Buckets are fixed at current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days past due rather than read from an AR_AGING_BUCKETS definition.
Amounts are in transaction currency; no conversion to ledger currency.
